stories.title: Man arrested on suspicion of aggravated burglary after police incident in Connah’s Quay
stories.summary: A 46-year-old man has been arrested on suspicion of aggravated burglary and affray after police went to an address on Church Street in Connah’s Quay. stories.title: Citizens Advice Cymru reports record debt levels among people seeking help in Wales
stories.summary: Citizens Advice helped nearly 194,000 people in Wales last year, with energy debt now the most common debt problem its advisers deal with.
